Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		overdueUsers: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.BorrowStatus = User::NORMAL and
		u.SuspensionDays>0 and
		u.LoanedBook->exists(l|l.DueDate<l.ReturnDate or
		(l.DueDate<now() and
		l.IsReturned = false)))
	precondition:
		overdueUsers.size()>0
	postcondition:
		overdueUsers->forAll(u: User|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays-1 and
		if u.SuspensionDays = 0 
		then u.BorrowStatus = User::SUSPEND 
		endif ) and
		result = overdueUsers
}
